summary.text: Justin Schoville is the Green Mountain Peace and Justice Party of Vermont candidate for the Vermont House of Representatives, Windsor-4 District, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Democrat Michael Hoyt and independent Kyle Hansen.
According to Ballotpedia, he is an attorney and small business owner.

paragraphs.text: Justin Schoville was born in New Orleans, Louisiana, according to Ballotpedia.
He earned a bachelor's degree from The George Washington University in 2011 and a graduate degree from the same university in 2013, and a law degree from Vermont Law and Graduate School in 2022.
His career experience includes working as an attorney and small business owner.

In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, Schoville described himself as an attorney who runs his own law firm using principles from worker cooperatives and as state chair of the Green Mountain Peace and Justice Party.

In that survey he said all Vermonters should have their basic needs met, including free health care, housing, education, child care, internet and elder care, and named workplace democracy as a policy area he is passionate about.
